svg.title: Known-best packing of 172 unit squares, regularized
svg.desc: A regularized derived view of the retained known-best n=172 construction, never the source witness: Evan Daniel's regularizer's view of it, its contacts re-solved exactly at the record's side, verified over the rationals (atlas/known-best/regularized/index.json), and rendered with the repository's deterministic house renderer. It changes no side, frontier value or evidence tier; the evidence stated here is the record's. Regularized by the Squares Project with Evan Daniel's regularizer (evand/square-packing, MIT).

sqpack:profile.sqpack:value: Complete 2026-11-10 rational centre-basis witness at 172, read exactly from the retained source file without its schema envelope: the n = 172 arrangement of issue 935 (T-282) re-solved, 1.6e-319 above what the source calls its exact local optimum. Finite construction feasibility only; the quintic, the local optimum, KKT, rigidity, same-packing, novelty, priority and global optimality are not replayed here.

svg.text: U n=172 regularized: side ~ 13.61468985 (certified upper bound)
